from tslearn.early_classification import NonMyopicEarlyClassifier
from sklearn.tree import DecisionTreeClassifier

# Initialize the early classifier with a simple base classifier
early_clf = NonMyopicEarlyClassifier(
    n_clusters=2,
    base_classifier=DecisionTreeClassifier(random_state=42),
    cost_time_parameter=1e-3,
    random_state=42
)

# Fit the model on the balanced dataset
early_clf.fit(X, y)

# Predict class and earliness
predicted_classes, prediction_timestamps = early_clf.predict_class_and_earliness(X)

# Verify the results
assert predicted_classes.shape == (X.shape[0],), f"Expected shape {(X.shape[0],)}, got {predicted_classes.shape}"
assert prediction_timestamps.shape == (X.shape[0],), f"Expected shape {(X.shape[0],)}, got {prediction_timestamps.shape}"
assert all(0 <= t <= X.shape[1] for t in prediction_timestamps), "Prediction timestamps must be within the series length"

print(f"__CHECK__ predict_class_and_earliness {predicted_classes.shape}, {prediction_timestamps
